en.aboutTitle:
Beyond the destination.
Made for the journey.
en.aboutIntro: PROM DRIVE begins with a simple idea: the right car can turn an ordinary journey into a memorable occasion. Our approach puts character, comfort and the little details of your journey first.
en.storyTitle: Chosen with taste. Considered with care.
en.story: A weekend escape, a business visit or a special occasion — choosing your car should feel effortless. We start with your plans, help you explore a suitable vehicle and service, and make room to discuss the details before you decide.

Care along the way

Choose around your driving style, your passengers and your occasion — not just a model name.
Discuss rental costs, dates, collection, return and terms before confirming your plans.

不止于目的地
更在意沿途的体验
zh.aboutIntro: PROM DRIVE 源于一个简单的想法：合适的座驾，能让平凡的出行成为值得记住的时刻。我们关注车辆的个性、乘坐的舒适，以及旅程中的每一处细节。
zh.storyTitle: 以品味甄选，以用心相伴
zh.story: 无论是周末度假、商务出行，还是重要场合，选车都应是一件轻松的事。从了解您的行程开始，探索合适的车型与服务方式，在决定前充分沟通细节。

沿途的贴心照顾

根据驾驶风格、同行人数及使用场景选择车辆，而不只是看车型名称。

从浏览车型到安排还车，为您的需求与疑问留出充分沟通的空间。
